prompt_text: Best donor CRM with online giving built in
response_text:
### Top Donor CRMs with Built-in Online Giving (2026)

Based on recent comparisons from nonprofit software reviews, here are the **best donor management CRMs with native online giving tools**. These platforms integrate donor tracking, CRM features, and seamless online donation processing without needing third-party add-ons. I prioritized options frequently ranked #1 or top-tier for ease of use, fundraising impact, and all-in-one capabilities. Bloomerang stands out as the most recommended overall.

| CRM | Key Features | Pricing Insight | Best For | Source Highlights |
|-----|--------------|-----------------|---------|-------------------|
| **Bloomerang** (Top Pick) | Unified donor CRM + online fundraising, engagement tools, reporting, donor retention scoring. Built-in forms, recurring gifts, text-to-give. | Starts ~$119/mo (nonprofit-friendly tiers). | Small-to-mid nonprofits focused on relationships & growth. | #1 in Bloomerang's 18+ best list [1]; top in Kindsight's 14 best [2]; strong in multiple reviews. |
| **DonorDock** | CRM, email, online giving, text, project mgmt, AI insights—all in one $500/mo plan. Intelligent stewardship woven in. | Flat $500/mo unlimited users. | Growing orgs wanting simplicity + AI without extras. | Excels in comparisons vs. competitors [3]. |
| **DonorPerfect** | Donor mgmt, gift/grant tracking, moves mgmt, mass mailing, built-in online forms & auctions. Robust reporting. | ~$89–$500+/mo based on records. | Established nonprofits with complex tracking needs. | Featured in top lists [5,6]; long-trusted for core donor tools. |
| **Giveffect** | 10-in-1: CRM, online donations, volunteer/email/accounting mgmt. Automates fundraising workflows. | Custom (affordable all-in-one). | Orgs seeking full automation across ops. | Top 22 CRMs [4]; #1 all-in-one claims [9]. |
| **Kindful (Funraise ecosystem)** | Donor tracking, online giving, journey mapping. Prioritizes online growth with efficient tools. | ~$109/mo+. | Digital-first fundraising with donor insights. | 11 impactful tools [7]. |

#### Why These?
- **Built-in Online Giving Confirmed**: All have native donation pages, payment processing (e.g., Stripe), recurring options, and CRM sync—no plugins required (unlike some like Salesforce add-ons).
- **Selection Criteria**: Drew from 2026-updated lists ranking by user reviews, features, and nonprofit fit. Bloomerang leads for its donor-centric design (e.g., engagement scoring boosts retention 25–50% per reviews).
- **Quick Comparison Tip**: Test free trials. Bloomerang/DonorDock shine for quick setup; DonorPerfect for scale.

For demos or custom needs (e.g., events/alumni), check sites directly. If you share org size/budget, I can refine!
